scope: 160 recorded study episodes, both knowledge settings; no pilot pooling, mixed models, H6, judge coding or costs
h1_joint: Maximum constituent raw p-value; separate main-family adjustment
averaging: Rounds within node, equally weighted members within node class, equally weighted episodes within condition; keep undefined conditional received shares missing, not zero; do not replace mean earnings with a product of separately averaged participation and shares.
h2: Common 15-class comparison across 7 networks; exclude triangle for every predictor, include pair; not a test
h5_weights: One sixth per eligible network; independent arms; two-sided within-network label permutations
immutable_stream_policy: Preserve every existing derive_seed label, row/class/episode order and batching detail. Do not replace keyed streams with a newly seeded global RNG.
